'''2018 MPC Shawn Dickson LS He Is The Chosen One''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Shawn Dickson]] at [[2018 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Shawn Dickson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance|V8-L-heisthechosenone.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open He Is The Chosen One Dickson LS.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-match-play-championships/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163128/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2018-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]
